correctness.rationale: The unicyclic cycle-plus-four-tails decomposition and series-resistance identities yield the exact rational Kirchhoff index for every permitted integer m,i,j. A fixed-cycle balance argument reduces to H(q)-3m/q; strict inequalities handle all five residue classes and every positive integer deviation. Exact independent rational Laplacian inversions for m=2..7 and exhaustive optimizer comparisons for m=2..100 corroborate the analytic proof, without being substituted for it.
